_doc: Lila's filmed Setup lines for the one-page Setup (round 22, the User 2026-10-15). Every film starts on one anchor (hub-lila-comms-b, eyes on the camera, mouth closed) and settles back onto it; a line is cut at end_f (its settle frame, measured on the lively set 2026-10-15) so it joins the next film or the listen loop with no held freeze. last_word_f is her last spoken word. scripts/setup-films-build.py cuts the sources into display/setup-films/<id>.mp4; the page (display/crissa-init.html) plays them itself.

welcome.line: Hi, I'm Lila. I'll set Crissa up with you on this page. I go from the top, and the part I'm on lights up.

you-mic.line: First, what should Crissa call you? Type your name, then say anything so we can see the microphone hear you.

computer.line: Next, this computer. Click Allow, and Crissa checks what it can run while we carry on.

vid-facing.line: Now Voice ID. At each beep, count to six. Twice facing the screen.

vid-left.line: Now turn a little to your left, and count at the beep.

vid-right.line: And a little to your right. Last one.

face.line: Two quick photos. Turn your head a little to the left, then to the right. Each one takes itself.
face._start_stop: round 30 (.101): face-start = this film to frame 38, 'Two quick photos.' (silencedetect: speech 0.55-1.58 s, next word 1.77 s; ASR of 0-1.625 s: 'Two quick photos.'), said before `already` when both sides came in during the counts

room.line: Your room. Tap the hour where your TV or speakers are, or tick Internal. Then tap your door.

hours.line: Last, your hours. When may Crissa restart, render and work on her own? Keep six to two, or change it.

already.line: Oh, you already did that, great!

done.line: That's everything. If you add the Krew pack, I'll be back to design and render new scenes and clips with you. Now here's Crissa.
done._krew_stop: round 23: with krew installed the line stops after "That's everything." (word ends 1.05 s, "If" starts 1.32 s; faster-whisper word times 2026-10-15)

wait.line: Take your time. I'll wait right here.
wait.when: A section sits open about 30 s with nothing happening. Once per section.

count-again.line: That one was a little quiet. Once more, a bit louder.
count-again.when: A Voice ID count comes out too quiet; the count is asked again after it.

further.line: A little further. There it is.
further.when: A face photo has not taken after about 5 s of turning.

setup-only.line: I'm just here for setup. Crissa can answer that in a minute.
setup-only.when: The ear hears speech outside a count or the mic test.

turn-quarter.line: Just a quarter turn. I need to see your face.
turn-quarter.when: A Voice ID face photo sees her turned too far (about a quarter turn or more).

turn-back.line: I can't see your face. Turn back a little.
turn-back.when: A Voice ID face photo finds no face while she turns.

look-once-more.line: Look straight at the camera once more.
look-once-more.when: The front face photo did not take.

rest-later.when: The face photo tries are spent; Setup moves on.
